column1: # vesma-node compatibility ledger — known-good (core, mesh) pairs.
# Format (tab-separated, # = comment):
#   core_tag <TAB> mesh_ref <TAB> mesh_version <TAB> verified <TAB> date
#   core_tag      git tag in the vesma repo (server venv/image is built from it)
#   mesh_ref      git tag OR commit sha in the vesma-mesh repo
#   mesh_version  what `mnemos-mesh version` must print for that ref
#   verified      how the pair was verified (live-laptop | staging | ...)
# vesma-node resolves the DEFAULT install/upgrade pair from the LAST
# data row of this file. An unknown (core, mesh) combination makes
# `upgrade` refuse with a hint (add a row or --force).
# Tag formats (Release naming — see contrib/node-install/README.md):
#   BOTH formats are valid ledger entries; the parser is format-agnostic
#   (any tag string is accepted as core_tag/mesh_ref identity).
#     historical : v4.3.7-mesh.2   (-mesh.N suffix; append-only history —
#                                    do NOT rewrite old rows)
#     new rows   : vX.Y.Z / vA.B.C (bare, no suffix) — from the next
#                  release the git tag carries NO -mesh suffix, and the
#                  ghcr image tag EQUALS the git tag:
#                  ghcr.io/vesmaro/vesma:<core_tag>,
#                  ghcr.io/vesmaro/vesma-mesh:<mesh_ref>.
# Seeded with the live laptop pair (2026-09-22). NOTE: the vesma
# pyproject still says 4.3.0 under tag v4.3.7-mesh.2 — the LEDGER is
# tag-based (core_tag is the identity); the binary version string is
# informational only (see status output for both).
